project.title: Worldwide distribution and environmental origin of the Adelaide Imipenemase (AIM-1), a potent carbapenemase in Pseudomonas aeruginosa
project.description: Carbapenems are potent broad-spectrum beta lactam antibiotics reserved for the treatment of serious infections caused by multidrug resistant bacteria such as Pseudomonas aeruginosa. The surge in P. aeruginosa resistant to carbapenems is an urgent threat as very few treatment options remain. Resistance to carbapenems is predominantly due to the presence of carbapenemase enzymes.

samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from wastewater metagenome
runs: Investigating antimicrobial resistance gene using metagenomic sequencing of wastewater
